Our pharmacy team needs a formal medication comparison done for patient PT-00142, who was admitted to the cardiology ward on November 15th. We have their pre-admission medication history and the inpatient orders that were placed on admission day — both are somewhere in the patient_data folder.

Please run the comparison and produce a file called `reconciliation_report.json` with the full structured results. The pharmacist specifically needs the verbose output included so she can review the matching logic. Make sure the report is complete — she'll be checking for any dose changes, anything that was stopped, anything newly added, and any safety alerts for high-risk drug classes.
